॥ Om, the specific word Om ॥ 1/2/5 ॥
[It is stated:] “This very Brahman they declare.” They do not declare that the individual self (jiva) is Brahman. [It is stated:] “This very one is Brahman, this very one is the Self, this very one is Savitar, this very one is Indra, this very one is Hari, who carries away the supreme bliss,” in the Indradhyumna branch. ॥ 5 ॥
